title: Fabulously Optimized for PVP
description: This is a Fork of the Fabulously Optimized Modpack with many additional Features for Minecraft PVP. It offers a big Performance boost and many good Mods for PVP.
body:
# 🛡️ Fabulously PvP-Optimized Modpack (Fork)

**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Base Pack:** Fabulously Optimized  
**Modloader:** Fabric  
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.x

---

## 🎮 Overview

Fabulously PvP-Optimized is a custom modpack forked from [*Fabulously Optimized*](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), designed specifically for **PvP players, competitive environments, and high FPS gameplay**, while maintaining beautiful visuals and resourcepack compatibility.

---

## ⚙️ Performance & Optimization

Built on the lightweight *Fabulously Optimized* foundation, this pack includes:

- **Sodium** – GPU performance boost
- **Lithium** – game logic optimizations
- **Phosphor** – lighting system improvement
- **FerriteCore** – memory optimization
- **Indium** – shader compatibility  
*(These core mods come from the base modpack)* :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8}

---

## ⚔️ PvP Enhancements

Included PvP-specific mods for competitive play:

- **Marlows Crystal Otimizer**
- **Shield Statuses** – display if Shields ar broken or not
- **Uku`s Armor HUD** – shows armor in vanilla like ectra Slots
*and many more...*
---

## 🖼️ Resource Packs & Visual Upgrades

Optional resourcepacks included for PvP aesthetics + clarity

---

## 💡 Quality of Life Additions

General QoL mods to improve usability:

- **Sodium** – boost performance & gives more graphic options
- **Zoomify** - Lets you zoom in realy far
- **Sound Controller** - lets you control *every* sound of the game
*and many more...*

---

## 📌 Features & Benefits

✔️ Massive FPS improvements over vanilla  
✔️ Optimized for low-end to high-end systems  
✔️ PvP HUD + UI built for competitive matches  
✔️ Compatible with most resourcepacks & shaders (via Fabric)  
✔️ Easy to extend with other mods

---

## 📝 Notes

- This pack does **not include client-side cheats or exploits**.  
- For **Hypixel or Ranked servers**, ensure no banned mods are active.  
- For balanced PvP, disable any mods that could be considered advantage-giving by server rules.

---

## 🤝 Credits
